content: golangci-lint latest v2.15.0 (proxy.golang.org verified). powerman/golangci-lint-strict publishes strict enable-nearly-all-linters configs pinned per exact golangci-lint version, latest config 2.15.0 (exact match); adoption rule: fetch config for the exact version, never edit upstream, extend in a separate file. golangci/golangci-lint-action latest v9.3.0 (v8+ = golangci-lint v2 only). go-ultimate recommends pinning the linter version in CI and invoking via go tool locally.
